title: Headlong: A Microharness for Persistent Agents
summary: Headlong is a lightweight framework for building and managing persistent AI agents, providing essential infrastructure for maintaining agent state, context, and execution continuity across sessions without the overhead of larger frameworks.
problem_solved: Simplifies the complexity of building persistent AI agents that need to maintain state and context across multiple interactions or sessions.
why_valuable: Reduces boilerplate and infrastructure complexity for developers building AI agent applications, making persistent agent development more accessible and maintainable.
